findings.evidence: Source review: load() returns while loading, so a successful pause/remove can skip its confirmation read and a pre-change refresh can later publish the old state.
Source review: concurrent reads lack ordering, so a pre-decline response can replace the newer empty requests list, or an older failure can publish an obsolete error.

draftCorrection: Each load has a revision; only the current revision publishes success or failure. Owner mutations invalidate earlier loads and request fresh confirmation. Session/participant checks fence owner mutation results.
